annotation.title_clean: Compulsory Motor Vehicle Liability Security Act
annotation.title_en: Compulsory Motor Vehicle Liability Security Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Republic of Korea (National Assembly; Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport)
annotation.venue: Korea Legislation Research Institute (KLRI) / Korea Law Translation Center
annotation.summary_en: Korean statute (as amended Oct. 2025) requiring compulsory liability insurance for motor vehicles, establishing owner liability, state compensation guarantees and a compensation fund. Amendments add autonomous driving provisions: insurer recourse for vehicle defects, an accident investigation committee, and mandatory autonomous driving information recorders.
key_provisions_or_claims: Owners must buy mandatory liability insurance; operating uninsured vehicles is penalised.
Operator bears liability for death or injury caused by vehicle operation (Art. 3).
Insurers may seek reimbursement from parties liable for autonomous vehicle defects (Art. 29-2).
Autonomous driving accident investigation committee can secure and analyse recorder data (Arts. 39-14 to 39-16).
Manufacturers must install autonomous driving information recorders; owners must retain data up to one year, with fines for violations.
